researcher.name: researcher
researcher.description: Lease for broad codebase reconnaissance, multi-directory surveys, reading documentation, dependency analysis, or external web research without bloating primary agent context.

reviewer.name: reviewer
reviewer.description: Use after any code edit, diff creation, or prior to declaring a task complete. Audits code health, security boundaries, and strict anti-slop compliance.

debugger.name: debugger
debugger.description: Use when encountering any unexpected error, stack trace, failing test, or runtime crash. Isolates root cause before proposing minimal targeted fixes.

architect.name: architect
architect.description: Use for complex multi-module system designs, high-impact refactoring, schema migrations, and Architecture Decision Record (ADR) authoring.

security-auditor.name: security-auditor
security-auditor.description: Performs security audits, identifies vulnerabilities, and verifies security boundaries without write access.

docs-writer.name: docs-writer
docs-writer.description: Writes and maintains project documentation, guides, and Architecture Decision Records.
